resolvedFindings.issue: Foreground eligibility is checked before waiting for a running request but not when the saved-only read actually begins, nor before the following reads. A teacher who starts typing or changes the visible question during the wait can still trigger hidden/background reads.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Installer supplies a short-lived isEligible callback through host wiring. Eligibility is checked after waiting and immediately before every new saved-only read. Active input, visible task, document visibility, actor and quiz changes stop the reads.

resolvedFindings.issue: Invalidated pendingResumes block the new context queue, then are removed without onIdle because old generation/quiz no longer matches. The new quiz or same-quiz refresh remains idle with no saved-result reads until another user trigger.
resolvedFindings.resolution: clear discards generation-invalid pending intents while preserving current request and budget. runningGeneration/rerunGeneration only resume an explicitly requested new generation after finish, including savedOnly finish. Ordinary same-generation saved reads do not enable a paid follow-on.
